description: Error chain: inference handler publishes content='' as a success envelope when message.content is null/blank. OMN-12660.
trigger: LLM API returns a choice where message.content is None or empty string
wrong_behavior: content = choices[0].get('message', {}).get('content') or '' → ModelInferenceResponseData(content='') treated as success
correct_behavior: blank content raises ValueError('API returned blank content') and routes to error_message path, never a success envelope
failure_mode: Delegation pipeline receives ModelInferenceResponseData(content='') as a success response; quality gate may pass on empty output; SEA renders node_name='unknown' from empty scaffold
regression_guard: ModelInferenceResponseData.content must never be empty string in a success envelope. blank content -> typed failure, always.
compatibility_note: Before adding Field(min_length=1) to ModelInferenceResponseData.content, audit all consumers to confirm no legitimate empty-content usage
